title: Undergraduate research (UGRP)
summary: UGRP, mini projects, Young Research Fellowship, Mitacs/Charpak/DAAD, CFI.

posts.md:
Apart from undertaking a project in the final year, undergraduate students can choose to pursue **Undergraduate Research Projects (UGRP)** by working under the guidance of a professor.

These projects provide students with an opportunity to gain hands-on research experience while exploring areas of interest beyond the classroom.

Additionally, the **Aerospace Engineering** and **Electrical Engineering** departments offer **Mini Projects**, giving students early exposure to research.

## Young Research Fellowship (YRF)

IIT Madras offers the **Young Research Fellowship (YRF)**, a **two-semester research programme** open to **B.Tech. and Dual Degree students in their fifth semester**.

Students can apply to **professor-led research projects**, and selected fellows receive:

- A monthly stipend.
- Funding for research-related expenses during the fellowship.
- Financial support to attend high-quality international conferences relevant to their research area.

## Research Internships & Publications

Students at IIT Madras also participate in prestigious international research internship programmes, including:

- Mitacs
- Charpak
- DAAD WISE

Many students also publish research papers and present their work at **national and international conferences**.

## Research Through CFI

Students can also engage in research and innovation through the **Centre for Innovation (CFI)**.

Some of the CFI clubs include:

- Programming Club
- AI Club
- iBot Club

Students can also join competition teams such as:

- **Avishkar Hyperloop**, which participated in the **European Hyperloop Week 2022**.
- **Team Anveshak**, which focuses on building a **Mars Rover**.
